en: What is this place? It feels very strange.
text: Ce loc este acesta? Se simte foarte ciudat.

en: Could this be where Reversal Mountain started from? The lair of the Pokémon Heatran?
text: Oare aici a început Reversal Mountain? Bârlogul Pokémonului Heatran?

en: They say Heatran is a Pokémon with magma-like blood flowing through it! Just imagine!
text: Se spune că Heatran este un Pokémon prin care curge sânge ca magma! Imaginează-ți!

en: The Magma Stone is glowing hot, as if something here calls to it...
Will you set it down here?

A deep rumble rose from below...
Something heavy dropped into the lair from above!
The rock here is warm to the touch.

Heatran let out a grinding roar!
The air of the lair shimmers with heat!
Heatran sank into the depths of the mountain...
